name: Workspace Keeper
description: Keeps windows on their original workspaces when an external monitor is connected or disconnected. When the primary display changes (unplugging a laptop from a monitor or dock, plugging one in, or choosing a new primary display in Settings), windows move to the new primary display and each returns to its own workspace instead of piling onto one. The active workspace stays the same. Works with fixed and dynamic workspaces on Wayland. Multi-monitor hotplug support, no configuration needed.
